We're POTYZHNI DONBASSYATA 🚀 

Proud of our roots, we carry a little coal spirit with us: tough, full of energy, and hard to burn out. We bring curiosity, creativity, analytical thinking, and a stubborn determination to get things done. Small team, big ambitions.
